steps.name: Step 1 — Create a seed credential named 'autotest_duplicate_cred_659174'
Step 2 — Navigate to a fresh create-credential form, fill Display Name with the SAME name, select Token auth, fill Access Token
Step 4 — Verify the error is visible to the user; form does not navigate away
Step 5 — Start a fresh form, fill Display Name only (baseline, non-soft): Save becomes enabled
Step 6 — Select Token auth, leave Access Token EMPTY: Save should be disabled (Known defect: #1004 — Save incorrectly stays enabled)
Verify no second duplicate-name record was created (list-absence check)
Cleanup — delete the seed credential and the empty-Token credential
